guards.v1_test: for every window the delivered raw text equals the sealed predecessor outside the accepted substitution spans and carries the identical whitespace-token count -- it ABORTS THE READ rather than producing a number
guards.v2_test: UNCHANGED from v1: a construction guarantee has no margin. For every window the delivered raw text equals the sealed predecessor outside the accepted substitution spans and carries the identical whitespace-token count; it ABORTS THE READ rather than producing a number

guards.v1_test: call-clustered CI90 UPPER bound on (KC-E1f - comparator) <= 0
guards.v2_test: call-clustered CI90 UPPER bound on (KC-E1f - comparator) corpus WER <= +delta, delta = the Earnings-21 own-null replicate's measured call-clustered CI90 half-width on corpus WER

guards.v1_test: CI90 LOWER bound on (KC-E1f - comparator) accuracy >= 0
guards.v2_test: call-clustered CI90 LOWER bound on (KC-E1f - comparator) call-pooled numeric-value accuracy >= -delta, delta = the Earnings-21 own-null replicate's measured call-clustered CI90 half-width on numeric-value accuracy

margin_source.source: computed here from SAEA-E21-FULL44-NULL-REPLICATE-V1's own per-window rows, through the same instrument; v1 had no margin for this quantity and the null cell's published table does not carry it

guards.v1_test: call-clustered CI90 UPPER bound on (KC-E1f - comparator) insertions per reference word <= 0
guards.v2_test: call-clustered CI90 UPPER bound on (KC-E1f - comparator) insertions per reference word <= +delta_ins, delta_ins = the half-width of the null replicate's OWN call-clustered CI90 on the SAME quantity, computed from its per-window rows through this same instrument

margin_source.source: SAEA-E21-FULL44-NULL-REPLICATE-V1 null table, semantic high-impact rate -- NOT USED AS A MARGIN: its own null excludes zero, so the guard stays advisory

guards.v1_test: advisory point estimate only; gates nothing
guards.v2_test: STAYS ADVISORY, now for a measured reason: this metric's own same-request null EXCLUDES ZERO, so no 'does not rise' clause is answerable on this carrier at any margin

no_number_moved.note: the v1 receipt's own decision block against the freshly recomputed one; identical draws, identical rows, identical estimator -- a single moved digit here would mean the recomputation is not the v1 read

conec_person_wer_percent.source: SAEA-E21-FULL44-NULL-REPLICATE-V1 null table, ConEC PERSON -- REPORTED, GATES NOTHING

insertions_per_reference_word.source: computed here from SAEA-E21-FULL44-NULL-REPLICATE-V1's own per-window rows, through the same instrument; v1 had no margin for this quantity and the null cell's published table does not carry it

semantic_high_impact_error_rate_percent.source: SAEA-E21-FULL44-NULL-REPLICATE-V1 null table, semantic high-impact rate -- NOT USED AS A MARGIN: its own null excludes zero, so the guard stays advisory

null_band_gate.note: the per-window reference-word attribution follows the alignment and moves when the hypothesis moves; the per-CALL total is the reference's own length and may not move, and the call is the bootstrap cluster

null_instrument_anchor.note: the same two row files, through this same instrument, must reproduce the null cell's OWN published corpus-WER interval to the digit before the over-generation band computed from them may be used as a margin

owner_decision: umbrella owner record Decision 9 of 2026-09-08, item 1 (re-decide the sealed KC-E1f pair under non-inferiority guards whose margins come from the Earnings-21 own-null replicate, with the v1 REJECTED verdict left standing beside it) and item 3 (every 'not worse' guard is a non-inferiority test with a margin fixed from the carrier's own null)

pairing.estimator: pooled ratio, sum(numerator) / sum(denominator) over the resampled units

vs_comparator.note: the multiple of the null half-width is REPORTED, never a threshold: the primary's own bar is unchanged at zero
vs_comparator.required: call-clustered CI90 lower bound > 0 -- UNCHANGED from v1

vs_ku_e1fc.note: the multiple of the null half-width is REPORTED, never a threshold: the primary's own bar is unchanged at zero
vs_ku_e1fc.required: call-clustered CI90 lower bound > 0 -- UNCHANGED from v1

rule.guards: every 'not worse' guard becomes a non-inferiority test: the CI90 bound on the HARMFUL side must not exceed that metric's margin, and the margin is the half-width of the Earnings-21 own-null replicate's own call-clustered CI90 on the same metric
rule.primary: UNCHANGED: call-clustered CI90 lower bound on the PERSON entity-WER reduction > 0 against the sealed comparator AND against KU-E1fc
rule.stated_before_any_number: docs/readiness/2026-09-08-e21-kc-e1f-repair-pass-v2-redecision.md section 2, committed before this script was first run
unchanged: both weightings reported: natural mixture and equal stratum
rule.verdict_map: ADMITTED iff the primary is met on both legs and every gating guard holds; NULL if either primary lower bound includes zero; REJECTED if any gating guard fails

supersedes_nothing: SAEA-E21-KC-E1F-VERDICT-V1 stays on record; this is a SECOND decision of the SAME sealed bytes under a different rule, not an amendment of the first
zero_contact: no model, GPU, tool, embedding, tokenizer, network, audio-decode or paid-API contact; no arm re-flown and no reference transcript opened here
